Mumbai Ganesh Pandal Electrocution Kills Two, Injures Four

During Ganesh idol immersion in Jogeshwari, a current spread in the immersion tank, resulting in the death of a youth. In the Lalbaug area, near a Ganesh pandal, a child and a woman died due to electrocution, and four others were injured. A case has been registered against the stall operator.
